result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate on 30 days’ written notice, receives a pro-rata refund of prepaid post-termination Fees, owes no early-termination or accelerated amounts notwithstanding the take-or-pay commitment, and Vendor has no convenience right during a term. Overriding Section 2.1 is necessary to make the termination right effective. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” creates an additional partial-scope termination right not required by the playbook and may create allocation ambiguity, so the redline is not strictly minimal. Otherwise, it is clear and professionally drafted.
